procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 ('Tunica County 2026 General Election' banner -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/tunica/; the rotation is opposite the Sharkey/Issaquena portrait family, like Humphreys/Noxubee). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (9/9).
structure_note: Same five-page shape as the other portrait Tier-1 counties: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 12 precincts (11 columns, then Workforce Center + TOTAL), and p4+p5 = the local School Board District Two row's two column groups (declared local_only). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller, Bennie G. Thompson, Bennie Foster -- the House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald); Chancery Court 7-1-Chancery District 7-1 Place 1 (Catherine Farris-Carter -- the same Place 1 section Quitman and Coahoma print, names identical); Circuit Court 11-3-Circuit District 11-3 (Charles E. Webster -- the same Place 3 candidate Quitman prints; Tunica's sheet prints ONLY the 11-3 section, so its Circuit 11 roster is a subset). Printed totals: Colom 1799, Hyde-Smith 546, Pinkins 40, Eller 527, G. Thompson 1788, Foster 62, McDonald 1653, Farris-Carter 1654, Webster 1753.
operator_rows_note: All 9 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; every row carries p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 ('Workforce Center' cell + printed TOTAL) cells. No X cells print in any in-scope row (the school-board X cells are local and contribute no parse rows).
truncation_note: No truncations; the twelve precinct headers print complete (Austin Park, Dundee Community Center, Hambrick, Mhoon Landing, New Sub Park, Robinsonville Community Center, Tunica, Tunica Auditorium, Tunica Economic Complex, Verner Park, White Oak Rec. Center, Workforce Center -- the sheet's own forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local 'School Board District Two-School Board' row (Lecretia 'Fruity' Williams Clark, X-celled outside Mhoon Landing/Tunica Auditorium/Verner Park) -- local, out of scope, declared local_only. Chancery 7's single printed Place 1 keeps the bare 'Chancery Court' label district 7 (matching Quitman/Coahoma's); Circuit 11's single printed Place 3 seat keeps the bare 'Circuit Court' label district 11 (the family's seat-blind roster record carries Quitman's/Coahoma's union).
